description: This file defines the DeleteCatalogItemResponse class, which is a part of the Public API for catalog item endpoints in the eShopOnWeb project. It inherits from BaseResponse and represents the response to a delete catalog item request, including a status property indicating the deletion status.

classes.description: Represents the response returned after a delete catalog item operation, including a status message and inheritance from BaseResponse.
